So many people just fundamentally don’t understand that infinity is a rhetorical device for mathematicians, not a thing that actually exists. The argument about infinite things is as useless as trying to divide 0 apples into the square root of negative one slices. It’s like trying to establish useful medical data by using a theoretical person with no actual biology. It’s just a time-wasting exercise for nerds to amuse themselves with. Change my mind.

I would absolutely play Sentinels Vs Capcom. Balerion in place of Shuma-Gorath, absolutely. Citizen Dawn for Magneto, possibly. Knyfe for Wolverine, definitely not.

There’s Perma-Steel and there’s Imperma-Steel, but they’re different, and nobody can explain exactly how.
